stem: One example of chemical control and co-ordination in plants is in the breakdown of food reserves during the germination of cereal grains, such as wheat.

parts.label: (a)
(a)(i)
parts.text: Name structures **A**, **B** and **C**, shown in Fig. 3.1.

parts.label: (a)(ii)
parts.text: With reference to the three numbered arrows in Fig. 3.1, describe the sequence of events that follows the uptake of water by the grain of wheat.

parts.label: (b)
(b)(i)
parts.text: With reference to Fig. 3.2, calculate the overall rate of increase in mean cell length over the time period shown.

parts.label: (b)(ii)
parts.text:
The pH of the cell walls decreased after the application of auxin.

Outline the events that occurred to cause this decrease in pH.

parts.label: (b)(iii)
parts.text: Explain the increase in the length of the cells following the decrease in pH of the cell walls.
